in_sanskrit.name: Imamul
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है God's servant
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Imamul एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। One who serves the almighty God. Derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Ima’ meaning God and ‘Mul’ meaning servant or servant of.

in_hindi.name: Imamul
in_hindi.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है God's servant
in_hindi.long_meaning: Imamul एक हिंदू नाम है जो भारतीय संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। One who serves the almighty God. Derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Ima’ meaning God and ‘Mul’ meaning servant or servant of.

in_tamil.name: Imamul
in_tamil.meaning: இந்து பெயர் என்று பொருள் God's servant
in_tamil.long_meaning: Imamul ஒரு இந்து பெயர் ஆகும், இது இந்திய கலாச்சாரத்தில் ஆழமான ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவத்தைக் கொண்டுள்ளது। One who serves the almighty God. Derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Ima’ meaning God and ‘Mul’ meaning servant or servant of.

in_telugu.name: Imamul
in_telugu.long_meaning: Imamul ఒక హిందూ పేరు, ఇది భారతీయ సంస్కృతిలో లోతైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక ప్రాముఖ్యతను కలిగి ఉంది। One who serves the almighty God. Derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Ima’ meaning God and ‘Mul’ meaning servant or servant of.

in_marathi.name: Imamul
in_marathi.long_meaning: Imamul हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who serves the almighty God. Derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Ima’ meaning God and ‘Mul’ meaning servant or servant of.

in_bengali.name: Imamul
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ God's servant
in_bengali.long_meaning: Imamul একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One who serves the almighty God. Derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Ima’ meaning God and ‘Mul’ meaning servant or servant of.
